risks.title: Cyberattacks and cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The risk is prioritized in the Risk Factors section with strong language indicating material exposure. Threat sophistication is increasing via AI. For a digital platform operating in 150+ countries with contributor data across 100+ countries, cybersecurity incidents could severely impact reputation, sales, and financial costs.

risks.title: Merger subject to antitrust regulatory approvals
risks.score_rationale: The merger with Getty Images (announced January 2025) faces significant hurdles: a DOJ request for information (April 2025) and a Phase 2 referral by the UK CMA (November 2025). Both agencies are currently reviewing the case. Lack of antitrust approval could block closing. This issue is central to the 2025 strategy.

risks.title: Dependence on AI and new technologies for security
risks.score_rationale: AI, cloud, and machine learning increase cybersecurity risks despite operational gains. Threat sophistication via AI continues to rise. Adoption of new technologies amplifies potential IT system vulnerabilities.

risks.title: Operational risk management and service continuity
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in over 150 countries with contributors in 100+ countries. This geographic and operational complexity, combined with reliance on IT infrastructure, creates systemic exposure to service disruptions, supplier failures, and system outages.

risks.title: Dependence on leadership and cybersecurity governance
risks.score_rationale: The Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) with 20+ years of experience is central to cybersecurity governance and reports quarterly to the Audit Committee. While governance structures exist, concentration around key individuals creates moderate dependency.

risks.title: Legal risks and litigation
risks.score_rationale: The document references a litigation section (Note 18 to financial statements) but provides no details on major litigation. For a global content company, IP rights and contract-related litigation risks are implicit but not quantified.

ai_positioning.summary: Shutterstock recognizes AI as an opportunity (image generation via algorithms, model training via metadata) and as an increasing cybersecurity risk. Cybersecurity threat sophistication is rising through AI. AI-generated content is part of the product catalog.
